:::{#exm-noise}
#### The noise of one observation

Suppose an observation has the [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\Predvar = \predvar$ with [mean function](#def-mean-function) value $\truemeanf{\predvar} = 5$.
If its outcome is $\Outvar = 5.3$, its [noise](#def-noise) is $\noise = 5.3 - 5 = 0.3$.
If its outcome is $\Outvar = 4.6$, its noise is $\noise = 4.6 - 5 = -0.4$.
The observation may belong to a [training set](#def-training-set) or be a [new observation](#def-new-observation):
the definition does not distinguish them.

:::
